body.name: Width-two uncertain-edge labels
body.construction: Define \(L:W^{\mathrm{proj}}\to2^{E^{?}}\) by \(L(\sigma)=L(t)=\varnothing\), \(L(u_\beta)=\{e^{\to},e^{\leftrightarrow}\}\cap E^{?}\) for \(\beta=(x,r,e^{\to},e^{\leftrightarrow})\), and \(L(u_e)=\{e\}\). For a directed path \(P\), set \(L(P)=\bigcup_{u\in P}L(u)\).
